title: China's role in Europe EV market
gist: Member-only listing for an 8-minute Benchmark analyst-insights video in which senior EV analyst George Whitcombe talks with senior editor Matthew Bird about the role of Chinese OEMs in Europe's growing EV market. The page also notes that Benchmark has started covering 10 new materials, including tungsten and silicon metal.

themes.theme: Chinese OEMs in Europe's EV market

insights.claim: Benchmark describes Europe's EV market as growing and says the role of Chinese OEMs in it is a topic of increasing interest.
insights.speaker: George Whitcombe, Senior EV Analyst, Benchmark; Matthew Bird, Senior Editor, Benchmark
insights.so_what: Chinese automaker share gains in Europe are a live competitive and policy issue for European OEMs and battery supply chains.
